title: PHASE 2 — momentum hardware matrix L3/L4/L11 (real A10 + real TDX, BF16 compute/FP32 master)

profiles.L11: O1-C hybrid plaintext-equivalent momentum (gamma-fed A in enclave, buffer in plaintext metric)

L11_O1C_protocol_exact.momentum_buffer_verification: the oracle reconstructs the plaintext-domain momentum buffer (buf=mom*buf+g_plain) from the REAL logged gradients and compares the resulting master each step; per-target master agreement (buffer-derived) at ~1e-8 DIRECTLY validates the buffer + transformed-momentum + corrected-target state, not just final output
L11_O1C_protocol_exact.verdict: O1-C momentum is plaintext-EXACT per target in the clean (pre-divergence) regime

hyperparameter_note_HONEST.observation: at the preregistered lr=1e-3 with mom=0.9 (effective LR ~1e-2 = lr/(1-mom)), single-batch training DIVERGES by step ~50 (L11 s1234 ce 0.445 -> 3.83, still finite). Both O1-C and O1-A are in the divergent regime, so the 50-step effective-equivalence top1 (L11 0.81-0.98) is UNINFORMATIVE about protocol correctness — it reflects training instability + bf16-forward sensitivity on large LoRA deltas, NOT a protocol defect.
hyperparameter_note_HONEST.clean_check: the 10-step per-target oracle (before divergence) is the valid protocol check and PASSES.
hyperparameter_note_HONEST.not_hidden: divergence retained and reported, not smoothed away; no NaN (all finite).
